top_signals.title: ECB Expected to Raise Interest Rates
top_signals.summary: The European Central Bank is set to raise borrowing costs for the second time since the start of the Iran war. The deposit rate will be lifted by a quarter-point to 2.5% on Thursday, according to all but one analyst in a Bloomberg poll. Bloomberg's Oliver Crook reports from Berlin. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trump Payout Pledge Adds to Bond Market Jitters as Auction Looms
top_signals.summary: The US President’s promise of a national cash payout for a Republican Party mid-term election victory is injecting fresh uncertainties into the Treasury market ahead of a 30-year bond auction, renewing concerns about Washington’s fiscal discipline and erratic policymaking.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
